summary: HEEBA backend + admin frontend end-to-end tested. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests passed against public preview URL — admin login+JWT, full CRUD (prizes/products/creators), settings GET/PUT, notifications create/list/delete, users list, admin points adjust, rewards list + status update, admin stats, and all user endpoints via seeded Mongo session (auth guards, /auth/me, /wheel/prizes|status|spin with 24h cooldown, /store/products+buy incl. insufficient points, /rewards, /transactions, /notifications+read, /creators, /me/avatar, /referrals/apply for self/bad/apply/duplicate). Frontend admin flow (mobile viewport 390x844) passed: login screen shows HEEBA branding + Google button + admin link, admin login with heeba@heeba.com/heeba lands on dashboard with stats + all 7 management cards, prizes (add TEST_UI_Prize appeared in list), products (add TEST_UI_Product appeared), settings save shows success toast, notifications send inputs render, users and orders screens load. No deprecated Expo packages detected in code paths reviewed. No React Native red-screen errors.
action_items: (minor) Consider adding console cleanup: web bundle emits deprecation warnings for shadow* props and props.pointerEvents from RN Web upgrades — not blocking but noisy.
(minor) useNativeDriver warning appears on web preview (harmless on web; will use native on device).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~960 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting into routers (admin, wheel, store, auth) for maintainability.
Referrals: /api/referrals/apply awards bonus to referrer immediately without any anti-abuse limit. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
Wheel weighted pick uses inclusive random.uniform(0, total) with r <= upto — acceptable; if all chances are 0 falls back to a 'nothing' prize or prizes[0]. OK.
clean() mutates the input dict (pops _id). Safe here because docs are used once, but consider returning a copy for defensive coding.
/api/files/{path} accepts an optional query token but does not validate it — currently public. Fine for images referenced in reward cards, but flag if sensitive files were ever stored.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a test user (user_test123, email test@heeba.com, referral_code TEST1234, 10000 pts) and session (token=testtoken123, 7-day expiry) directly in MongoDB via pymongo. Left in place after tests (see conftest note) since xdist workers share Mongo; safe to purge from admin panel or Mongo shell later. TEST_-prefixed prizes/products/notifications/creators created during CRUD tests are soft-deleted by the tests themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Seeded user 'user_test123' with session token 'testtoken123' remains in the shared Mongo (users + user_sessions) — reuse for USER endpoint testing (Bearer testtoken123). Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope; fixtures avoid teardown deletion to prevent cross-worker races. UI: send-notif button testID is 'send-notif' (not 'notif-send'). Notification-send end-to-end already verified via backend CRUD tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. During test authoring, an initial cross-worker race (session-scoped fixture deleting shared Mongo user_sessions row while another xdist worker still needed it) was resolved by removing the fixture teardown and keeping upsert-only setup.
